lines.zh: 我四条腿迈得很快，牙露在外面。
lines.en: My four legs move fast, teeth bared.
My hind legs are coiled to spring.

lines.zh: 我一跃就把距离缩短一半。
lines.en: One leap halves the distance.
One jump and I reach your head.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，直奔你这边。
lines.en: I go round the stone and head straight for you.
My tail lashes behind me.
I sniff the ground as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下爪印。
lines.en: Claw marks are left where I walk.
I stop and tilt my head at you.
I tread the mud and close in step by step.
I move sideways along the mud.

lines.zh: 我一转身，尾巴扫倒一片草。
lines.en: I turn and my tail flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我从水里爬上来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I climb out of the water and shake.
I raise my head toward you.

lines.zh: 长腿一跨，我绕到你侧面。
lines.en: One long stride and I am at your flank.
I crouch with my teeth outside my mouth.
I lift my head and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 我的后腿绷着，随时能跳。
lines.en: My hind legs are braced, ready to spring.
Mouth wide, I am shedding heat.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，牙还露在外面。
lines.en: My eyes half-shut, tusks still showing.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴在地上来回摆。
lines.en: I sweep my tail back and forth.
I wait for you to show a gap.
Water still drips off me.
I lower my head and lift it again.
I tilt my head, as if reckoning distance.
I scrape the ground with one foreclaw.
I turn on the spot, slowly.
My back tenses into a line.
I close my jaws, then open them.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥里，尾巴拍了一下。
lines.en: I lie in the mud and slap my tail once.
Your head looks easy to bite.
I know living things.
I open my jaws wide for you.
Do not back away; I will chase.
My teeth crowd in rows.

lines.zh: 你身上有骨头驯服的味道。
lines.en: You smell of the bone that tamed me.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，像要搭上你。
lines.en: I lift a foreclaw as if to rest it on you.

lines.zh: 我在你面前显得很小，可很快。
lines.en: I look small before you, but I am quick.
I am watching your breathing.

lines.zh: 你抬脚之前，我已经准备扑。
lines.en: Before you lift a foot, I am ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 我们之间没什么好谈的。
lines.en: There is nothing to discuss between us.

lines.zh: 我把头放低，看着你的脚。
lines.en: I lower my head and watch your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的兽的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of another beast.

lines.zh: 我给你一次机会，转头走。
lines.en: I give you one chance: turn and go.
I slowly grin at you.

lines.zh: 你站在我的跳跃距离外吗？
lines.en: Are you outside my leaping range?
I sniff your weapon.
Your hands are more honest than your face.
I dislike being underestimated.
Better not look into my eyes.
I snarl and back off half a metre.

lines.zh: 跳得太猛，落地时腿发麻。
lines.en: I jumped too hard; my legs numb on landing.

lines.zh: 我这口獠牙，低头就是为了咬。
lines.en: These fangs; I lower my head to bite.
That stopped me for a moment.
My jaws hang open and I pant hard.
Wounded, I back into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我的身体一抖，泥掉了一层。
lines.en: I shudder and a layer of mud falls.
I flatten down, ready to bolt.
That hurt.
I grit my teeth and bear it.
Bone? Let me smell it.

lines.zh: 肉味一飘，我的后腿就痒。
lines.en: One whiff of meat and my hind legs itch.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我扑到你面前。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs and I am at your face.

lines.zh: 你举高一点，我后腿一蹬就够得着。
lines.en: Hold it higher; one kick of my hind legs reaches.
That smell makes me want to obey.
I crouch and wait for you to give it.
A bone? Let me smell it first.

lines.zh: 骨头拿来，我让你摸獠牙。
lines.en: Hand over a bone and you may touch my tusks.
Put it on the ground, then I will take it.
I push toward that bone.
There is meat on your fingers.
I call again, softly.
If you will not give it, I will take it.
I sit down, tail tucked.
I open my mouth to take it, carefully.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓着，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your pocket bulges; I can smell it.
I press against your leg.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，把你推歪。
lines.en: I hit your leg and knock you off balance.
You charge and I duck under.
My teeth graze your sleeve.
We collide and I roll over.
Shoved off, I come back quickly.
I leap and plant a foot on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我咬了一下。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I snap once.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我的爪划到地面。
lines.en: At the impact, my claws rake the ground.
We part and I brace low on the ground.

lines.zh: 獠牙擦过你，我偏了半步。
lines.en: My tusks graze you; I veer half a step.
My mouth is all teeth.
I am bad-tempered; not suited to this.
I lift my head and lose interest.
Give me the bone first.
I lie down and turn my head away.
That can wait for later.
My hind legs carry me a long way.
You ask too politely.
Offer a bone and I obey.
I get up and walk away.
One bite and half of it breaks.
I grip it in my teeth and drag it over.
I pin it under a foreclaw.
This will keep me chewing a while.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我咬住就不放。
lines.en: I clamp this bone and will not drop it.
I do not eat this, but I will take it.
Two bites and I drop it.
I bury it in the mud.
What falls belongs to me.
I carry it off behind a tree.
Of all the marsh smells, I know only yours.
You are within my leaping range.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我直接扑到头。
lines.en: One push of my hind legs and I go for the head.

lines.zh: 泥水一动，我的长吻对准你。
lines.en: The water stirs; my long snout aims at you.
I have your position.
I am about to spring.

lines.zh: 满嘴獠牙，已经对准你脖子。
lines.en: A mouthful of tusks aims at your neck.

lines.zh: 还站着的那个，就是我的猎物。
lines.en: The one still standing is my prey.
I have the scent fixed; no changing.
I begin shifting toward you.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在泥里，我跟着踩。
lines.en: Your footprints are in the mud; I follow them.
You run, and I chase in leaps.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，在泥地上很清楚。
lines.en: Your sweat stands out clearly on the mud.
You look back and I am behind.
I bring the gap down to one step.

lines.zh: 后腿绷紧，我瞄准你的头。
lines.en: Hind legs taut, I aim for your head.
You are slowing; I can tell.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，直接扑到你脸前。
lines.en: One push of these legs and I am at your face.
You hide in the grass; I can smell you.
I have not let go of this.
I spring and bite at your head.
My jaws close on your shoulder.
That knocks you down.
I bite down on your arm.
I hook you with a foreclaw and hold.
That one came with mud and water.
My tusks close on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你被我的牙划开了一道。
lines.en: My teeth open a gash in you.

lines.zh: 我咬着后退，把你拖过来。
lines.en: I bite and pull back, dragging you.
That one only caught armour.
I leap out of the muddy water.

lines.zh: 你听见草被压平的声音。
lines.en: You hear the grass being flattened.
The first thing to appear is a row of teeth.
I spring out from behind a stone.
I land and shake off water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从林子里绕出来。
lines.en: I come slowly out of the trees.

lines.zh: 我弓着身子出现在你侧面。
lines.en: I appear at your side, back arched.

lines.zh: 我一声低吼，然后走出来。
lines.en: A low growl, then I step out.
I crawl out of a burrow.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the birds flee.

lines.zh: 我在你后面三步处站着。
lines.en: I stand three paces behind you.
A row of tusks rises from the marsh.

lines.zh: 火燎到尾巴，我猛地跳开。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail and I spring away.
I land hard and roll over.
Water fills my mouth and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我的背上，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back and I twist to bite it.
Magic hits and my legs stiffen.
Hungry enough that my legs shake.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一蹬，就到你面前。
lines.en: One push of my hind legs and I am on you.
The void pulls and all four claws dig in.
